candidates.change_summary: Replace `return _owner;` with `return address(0);` so owner() always returns the zero address instead of the actual owner.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier from transferOwnership to allow anyone to call it.
Replace the zero-address check with a requirement that newOwner equals the current owner, preventing any ownership change.
Delete the zero-address check, allowing transfer to address(0) and enabling a second renounce after first.
Invert the ownership check so that only non-owners can call onlyOwner, breaking all onlyOwner guards.
Remove the entire _checkOwner body so onlyOwner never reverts, granting public access to all onlyOwner functions.
Change return value from _name to a hardcoded string literal.
Change the return value of symbol() from the state variable `_symbol` to a hardcoded string "MODIFIED".
Change the return value of decimals() from 18 to 6
Change totalSupply to return a hardcoded constant value instead of the actual _totalSupply state variable
Change totalSupply to return _totalSupply plus a fixed offset, altering the reported supply
Change totalSupply to return balanceOf of a specific address instead of _totalSupply
Make totalSupply return 0 always, no matter the minted amount
Always return zero instead of the actual balance
Change return value from true to false in transfer function
Return a hardcoded value instead of _allowances[owner][spender] so allowance always returns the same value
Return the opposite mapping order _allowances[spender][owner] so the allowance value observed is from a different storage slot
Return the sum of allowances in both directions so the returned value differs from the original
Return balanceOf(owner) instead of allowance, making allowance return a different value
Return totalSupply instead of allowance, making the return value unrelated to the original allowance
